claim_audit_results.claim_summary: BIODIV-01 is a Research and Innovation Action under the destination Biodiversity and ecosystem services
The topic sets three expected outcomes (EO-01, EO-02, EO-03)
The destination sets six longer-term expected impacts (EI-01..EI-06), at destination level not topic level

The central result is one reusable observation chain carrying measurement from molecules to satellites along a single agricultural pressure gradient from farmland through freshwater ecotones to coastal waters
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase8_drafting_review/canonical_reference_pack.json (objective O4: single agricultural pressure gradient across three realms)

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The three demonstration cases share one pressure and one measurement protocol, so a harmonisation decision is tested in realms that did not design it (D4.4)
The named result deliverables D2.2, D3.1-D3.4, D5.3, D6.1-D6.3 and D7.2 carry the canonical titles the section uses
The project fixes twelve impact indicators, each measuring something it delivers and each naming one deliverable
Each impact indicator names a deliverable that exists in the work plan
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase8_drafting_review/canonical_reference_pack.json (deliverables D2.1, D4.1, D4.4, D6.1-D6.3, D3.2, D3.4, D7.1, D7.3, D5.3)

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: No target numbers are fixed for the indicators yet
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Operator-declared assumption; targets await consortium confirmation. Explicitly declared, not accepted as Confirmed.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The project duration is 48 months
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/working_assumptions.json (project_duration: 48 months); mirrored in selected_call.json field_status Assumed
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: No Tier 2B source evidences a duration; operator-declared and can never be Confirmed.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The valuation clause of the fourth destination impact is only partly addressed; the project improves the evidence a valuation rests on but runs none, as no partner carries environmental economics
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Source marks the valuation clause Unresolved; the gap is disclosed, not resolved.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The demonstration case realms are terrestrial P03, freshwater P07, marine P08
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Project fact resting on operator-declared, unconfirmed partners (P07, P08 fictional); declared Assumed, not Confirmed.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Use of the European earth observation and satellite navigation programmes is an eligibility condition for satellite data under this topic
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/project_summary.json (claim C03, call_phrase 'Copernicus and/or Galileo/EGNOS', call_phrases Confirmed)

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: The Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, Marine Strategy Framework Directive and EU Nature Restoration Regulation are the reporting obligations named for this topic
A plan for dissemination and exploitation including communication is an admissibility condition, with a more detailed plan as a mandatory deliverable updated periodically
WP7 'Policy uptake, sectoral mainstreaming and exploitation' carries dissemination, exploitation and communication, consolidated in D7.4
The Data management plan and shared metadata profile (D1.1), due at month 6, fixes the open-data and FAIR commitments
The action is a Research and Innovation Action, not an Innovation Action, so no path to commercialise an innovation is required
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/call_binding/selected_call.json (instrument_type RIA, Confirmed); IA-only commercialisation requirement in section_schema_registry.json B.2.2

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Dissemination is open FAIR release of the protocols, crosswalks, pipeline, training resource, models, maps and genome-to-space report to the open science cloud and common data spaces
The measures are proportionate to a Research and Innovation Action of EUR 5,000,000 funding two projects
Exploitation carries biodiversity indicators into farm-management tools via D7.2 and D7.3
The uptake channel is P05's multi-country user network, a partner whose participation is assumed
claim_audit_results.flag_reason: Project fact resting on operator-declared, unconfirmed partner; the draft itself flags participation as assumed.

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: A measurement protocol transfers to a second production context, resting on P06 whose participation is assumed

claim_audit_results.claim_summary: Outputs are shaped to the reporting obligations via the Policy reporting needs assessment (D7.1) and the Interoperability crosswalk package (D3.2), feeding monitoring and review
Crosswalked labels and occurrence records make progress on international biodiversity commitments countable, the sixth destination impact
The reusable observation chain is released under open terms so use continues after the project, with reuse measured through the indicators and recorded in the Final project report (D1.3)

Many in-situ collections 'were not designed with Satellite Remote Sensing integration in mind' and 'lack the structure, interface and metadata required to support advanced analytics, including AI', so reconciliation is done once per project and discarded
claim_audit_results.source_ref: docs/tier3_project_instantiation/project_brief/concept_note.md (section 'The gap the topic names', verbatim quotes)
